concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a high quality 3D game combat concept illustration for Pelican 429. Input image 1 is the locked character, equipment and rendering-style reference, not a layout to copy. Preserve Grassy's exact identity: adorable young stylized programmer, roughly 3.1-head-tall proportions, very large rounded head, short layered dark brown hair, large brown eyes, red textured knit sweater, blue cuffed JEANS, cream sneakers, compact white graphite cyan sci-fi wrist guards and waist/back flight rig. Same recognizable silver-and-dark mechanical keyboard, real raised keycaps. Preserve short limbs, do not turn him into a tall teenager, don't enlarge the equipment. Premium animated-film 3D finish, softly rounded forms, physically shaded fabric and metal. Dark desaturated blue studio/game-arena floor and backdrop; no UI, no photorealism, no gore, no unrelated weapons, no watermark. The concepts must be feasible as game meshes plus particles, keep opaque objects readable inside glow, don't erase forms with white bloom.
Primary request: Show that a KEYBOARD IS A MELEE BLUNT WEAPON, alternating powerful LEFT and RIGHT horizontal swings at an enemy, not typing and not hitting the floor. Wide 16:9 action design image containing only TWO clearly separated sequential key poses of this SAME combo, arranged left then right. Small clean Chinese labels '01 左挥' and '02 右挥'. Each pose shows the full character planted on the floor; both hands grip the ends/edges of the rigid keyboard with fingers wrapped around the frame; the keyboard is swung broadside at chest height across his body like a heavy rectangular club. First pose: torso twists and arms follow through from his right toward his left; second pose: reverse backhand swing from his left toward his right. Strong contrary torso rotation and staggered footwork, bent knees, readable physical weight and shoulder motion. Keyboard stays below the chin and clear of the face and torso. A short cyan-white crescent ribbon and scattered orange-white impact fragments trace each opposing horizontal trajectory, with subtle directional chevrons. Small neutral gray sci-fi training target beside the strike tip makes it obvious the keyboard hits an opponent at torso height. Targets are simple nonliving mannequins, secondary, no blood. Do not hold the keyboard as a typing tray, do not raise it overhead, do not kneel and smash the floor. The solid keyboard and two opposing poses are the visual priority. Rich cloth/metal detail, sharp kinetic rendering.
